results.title: Die dritte Hochzeit
results.overview: Ingeborg Caspari, a successful businesswoman and matriarch, is getting married at over seventy - for the third time, to a much younger man. To celebrate the occasion, she invites her family to the family estate. Among the guests are her three adult children—Andreas, Philipp, and Katrin—along with their partners and children; even her ex-husband, Henning, doesn’t want to miss the spectacle.

results.title: Tabi Tabi Po

results.title: Imminence: Axis Mundi

results.title: A Formal Visit
results.overview: A workplace comedy following the final, chaotic moments at a small business getting ready for a presidential visit.

results.title: Aftermath
results.overview: An artificial forest that once supported Japan's post-war reconstruction has been swallowed by modern economic waves and left abandoned. Through the perspective of a single forestry worker who has dedicated his soul to the mountains, this soulful documentary questions the "importance of mountain-building" that we have forgotten, sounding an alarm about the desolate future of Japan's forests.

results.title: Peak
results.overview: Kao is a junior high school student attending an elite cram school. She shares a close friendship with Nanase, whom she has known since middle school, and the two often pass the time between studies daydreaming about opening their own cafe together. However, their cram school homeroom teacher, Ohno, mocks their aspirations as the "peak of their lives." Furthermore, Kao's mother expresses prejudice against Nanase based on the school she attends. Losing confidence in her friendship with Kao, the protagonist feels overwhelmed - until words from the manager of a cafe they visit together help lift her spirits.

results.title: Collection
results.overview: Visiting a bar with a female friend, Anne meets up with a "personal shopper" working behind the counter. Her brief joy upon holding a limited-edition item released just that morning quickly turns into confusion when she is quoted a price far exceeding the retail value. While the seller defends it as "matching the market value," Anne pushes back fiercely, arguing that it is nothing more than scalping. As the night deepens, they trade words over the true value of their cherished collections and the items they desperately desire.

results.title: Second Hand
results.overview: A plainclothes policeman, wanting to light his cigarette, asks a waste picker, unaware that he is a refugee, for a lighter; this exchange turns into a darkly comic moment that exposes the tension between the visible and the invisible.

results.title: Oromi and Juriemon
results.overview: Set in the late Edo period, this film is a gender-reversed, samurai-style musical adaptation of Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet. It follows Oromi, the spirited daughter of a prominent samurai family, and Juriemon, the gentle heir of a rival clan who prefers dance over combat. When the two cross paths and fall in love during a festival, their secret romance sparks a perilous chain of events, forcing them to defy their families' bitter feud and navigate a tragic fate in a world bound by honor and tradition.

results.title: White Death
results.overview: After years of a marriage marked by conflict and tension, an elderly couple heads to a registry office to file for divorce, only to face a shocking truth: according to official records, they are both dead. As they wander through the cold, endless corridors of bureaucracy in search of proof that they are alive, they rediscover a long-forgotten love. What was meant to be the end of a shared life becomes the beginning of a new one.

results.title: The Eldest Daughter
results.overview: In the aftermath of her brothers' mental health crisis, the eldest daughter struggles to navigate her culture to keep her family together.

results.title: Restless Rhythms
results.overview: Two estranged brothers, raised in different regions and devoted to different religions, reunite after their father’s sudden death. Instead of mourning together, they clash over how his funeral rites should be performed, each determined to honor him through his own faith. Old wounds, pride, and belief fuel their conflict until a violent turn in nature disrupts the ceremony. As chaos unfolds, their certainties begin to collapse, exposing the fragility of human ego, faith, and division.
